(1) the expression of LEC, FUS3 or ABI3 mRNAs during seed development is not correlated with the establishment of dormance in Arabidopsis, (2) ABI3 expression is not correlated with dormancy, and (3) LEA gene expression is correlated with dormancy.

LEC1, ABI3 and FUS3 expression during seed maturation does not correlate with the level of dormancy, that ABI3, At-Em1 and At-Em6 are expressed similarly in dormant and non-dominant seeds, and that ABI3, Em1 and Em6 expression is not altered in nsm mutants.

(1) LEC1, ABI3, FUS3 transcripts are not correlated with dormancy establishment in Arabidopsis, (2) ABI3, AtEM1 and AtEM6 mRNA abundances are not correlated with the release of dormancy in the nsm mutants, and (3) ABI3, Em1 and Em6 mRNA abundance is not correlated with the dormancy-breaking process in the precociously germinating mutant, abi3-1.
